instruction_id: EBTA KHUSUS JILID 1 INI JIKA BELUM MENGUASAI ULANG-ULANGILAH ! BILA SUDAH LANCAR DAN BENAR BOLEH DINAIKKAN
instruction_en: FINAL EVALUATION SPECIFICALLY FOR VOLUME 1: IF NOT YET MASTERED, REPEAT IT OVER AND OVER! WHEN FLUENT AND CORRECT, YOU MAY ADVANCE
